title: Composer Adds X-Extra Large Size & Scheduled Hibernation
summary: Cloud Composer environments can now be provisioned in an X-Extra Large size. Additionally, `DEVELOPMENT` mode environments can configure scheduled hibernation and resumption, enabling cost savings and automated management.
details: Developers can now provision Cloud Composer environments with an `ENVIRONMENT_SIZE_X_EXTRA_LARGE` option, providing more capacity for demanding workflows. More significantly, a new `scheduledHibernationConfig` property has been added to the `EnvironmentConfig` schema. This allows you to define cron-based schedules for automatically hibernating and resuming `DEVELOPMENT` mode environments. The new `ScheduledHibernationConfig` schema includes `enabled` (boolean), `hibernationSchedules` (array of cron strings), `resumptionSchedules` (array of cron strings), and `timeZone` to manage environment lifecycle, offering significant cost savings and operational efficiency for non-production environments.
